projects.title: West Coast Summit Supply
projects.description: West Coast Summit Supply is a fictional outdoor gear store brought to life through a custom-built e-commerce website. Designed with WordPress and WooCommerce, this project served as the capstone for the BCIT FWD program.
key-features: Custom WP Hooks & Templates - Enhanced functionality with templates and custom WordPress hooks
Custom JavaScript - Improved interactivity and dynamic elements for a smooth user experience
Google Maps Store Finder - Integrated a store locator using the Google Maps API
